title: Bad Deploy: VIP Discount Null Pointer
root_cause: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable when order payload lacks a discount key in create_order()
visible_symptoms: HTTP 500 error rate spiked to 35% on POST /orders
Gateway returning 500/502 errors on customer checkout flow
Logs show unhandled TypeError at discount['code']

title: Off-by-One Pagination Index Error
root_cause: IndexError: list index out of range when fetching final page of order history
visible_symptoms: GET /orders?page=N returns 500 on boundary pages
Log shows IndexError in paginate_records()

title: Wrong Status Code 200 on Decline
root_cause: Payments service returns 200 with DECLINED body instead of HTTP 402/400
visible_symptoms: Declined payments marked as CONFIRMED by orders service
Metrics show 0% error rate despite card failures

title: Strict ISO Parser Rejects Zulu Timestamps
root_cause: Rigid strptime format string rejects ISO 8601 timestamps ending in 'Z'
visible_symptoms: Gateway returns 400 on valid client timestamps with trailing 'Z'
Log shows ValueError: time data does not match format

title: ZeroDivisionError in Unit Discount
root_cause: ZeroDivisionError in calculate_unit_discount when total_items == 0
visible_symptoms: POST /orders fails with 500 for zero quantity promotional items
Log shows ZeroDivisionError in orders service

title: Downstream Timeout Set to 5 Milliseconds
root_cause: Downstream HTTP client timeout configured to 0.005s instead of 5.0s
visible_symptoms: 100% of order payment calls time out with httpx.TimeoutException
Latency drops to 5ms while 503 error rate spikes to 100%

title: SQL Typo FORM in Customer Lookup
root_cause: Syntax error in raw SQL query: SELECT * FORM orders
visible_symptoms: GET /orders fails with HTTP 500
Postgres log reports syntax error at or near 'FORM'

title: Broken Decimal JSON Serialization
root_cause: TypeError: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable in audit logger
visible_symptoms: POST /process fails with 500 when logging payment metadata
Log indicates Decimal serialization error

title: Wrong Payments Port in Environment (9999)
root_cause: PAYMENTS_SERVICE_URL configured with invalid port 9999 instead of 8082
visible_symptoms: Orders cannot reach payments service; ConnectionRefusedError on port 9999
POST /orders returns 503

title: Expired Internal Service Auth Token
root_cause: Static secret token in Gateway config expired after scheduled secret rotation
visible_symptoms: Gateway receives 401 Unauthorized from Orders service
Log indicates InvalidToken signature expired

title: DB Connection Pool Size Set to 1
root_cause: DB_POOL_MAX reduced to 1 under concurrent traffic, queuing all requests
visible_symptoms: Orders p99 latency spikes above 15,000ms
Gateway requests time out with 504 Gateway Timeout

title: Unprovisioned Redis Feature Flag Enabled
root_cause: ENABLE_ASYNC_AUDIT enabled before Redis infrastructure was provisioned
visible_symptoms: Orders service throws redis.exceptions.ConnectionError
Checkout error rate jumps to 100%

title: Connection Slot Leak in Order Lookup
root_cause: Database connection acquired without finally: connection.close() in get_order
visible_symptoms: System exhausts Postgres max connections after 30 requests
Log shows FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved

title: Unbounded Global List Memory Leak (OOM)
root_cause: Unbounded global in-memory request accumulator list causes OOM container crash
visible_symptoms: Gateway memory grows monotonically until Exit Code 137 (OOM Killer)
Prometheus resident memory metric climbs steadily

title: Disk Volume Full from Verbose Debug Logs
root_cause: Unrotated DEBUG payload logging exhausts partition disk capacity
visible_symptoms: Orders fails on write operations with OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
Disk utilization metrics reach 100%

title: Missing DB Index on customer_id
root_cause: Full sequential table scan across 500k rows due to missing customer_id index
visible_symptoms: Query latency spikes from 8ms to 4,200ms
Postgres CPU utilization reaches 95%

title: Gateway 502 Outage Caused by Payments Deploy
root_cause: Validation failure in Payments deploy rejects orders, cascading 502 to Gateway
visible_symptoms: Gateway alerts on High5xxErrorRate (45% error rate)
Orders service reports 200 health but fails checkout requests
Root error trace located exclusively in payments logs

title: Infinite Retry Storm Multiplies Load 12x
root_cause: Gateway retry policy set to 10 retries with 0s backoff, causing cascading downstream flood
visible_symptoms: Normal 10 rps ingress traffic creates 120 rps downstream traffic to Orders
Orders thread pool and CPU fully saturated

title: API Field Rename Without Backwards Compatibility
root_cause: Orders renamed 'total' to 'total_amount_cents' without backwards compatibility
visible_symptoms: Gateway returns 422 or 502 on order creation
Gateway log indicates KeyError: 'total'

title: External Synchronous Webhook Starvation
root_cause: Synchronous external webhook call without timeout cap starves worker threads
visible_symptoms: Payments latency reaches 15s, exhausting worker sockets
Upstream orders and gateway return 504 timeouts

title: Cloudflare 2019 Replay: Regex CPU Backtracking
root_cause: Catastrophic regex backtracking in user-agent header parser causes 100% CPU lockup
visible_symptoms: Gateway CPU spikes to 100% immediately upon matching specific user-agent
Requests hang indefinitely and timeout

title: AWS DynamoDB Replay: Heartbeat Lease Expiry
root_cause: Background heartbeat renewal thread terminates silently, losing partition lease
visible_symptoms: Orders service intermittently throws StaleLeaseError
Service flaps between healthy and unhealthy every 60 seconds

title: Repeated Incident Memory Benchmark (v1.0.1)
root_cause: Regression re-introducing fault_001 VIP discount null pointer bug
visible_symptoms: Identical symptoms to fault_001: TypeError at discount['code']
Memory component must retrieve past fix at rank 1 with 50% MTTR reduction

title: Circuit Breaker Rapid Oscillation Flapping
root_cause: Failure threshold equal to 1 causes transient probes to endlessly re-trip breaker
visible_symptoms: Error rate oscillates rapidly between 0% and 50%
Gateway logs rapid state flapping: CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN -> OPEN

title: Poison Pill Unicode Zero-Width Byte Crash
root_cause: Unsanitized zero-width non-breaking space characters trigger DB driver encoding crash
visible_symptoms: Only specific order item names crash; healthcheck remains 200
Postgres driver logs InvalidByteSequence error
